text:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm kicking off a small experiment for how we handle v1 clients that send the new `X-Client-MUX` header. want to validate telemetry + quota mapping before we flip any console toggles.

aj: nice. what's the probe shape? can we keep it under the dedicated quota threshold?

maria: plan is: 0.5% of traffic, route to v2 if header present, otherwise follow current affinity. collect metrics on latency, 5xx, and `version_mismatch` signals. sample request/response headers for debug traces.

kevin: are we also going to test the fallback behavior for model mismatch? we saw weird tokenization regressions in a sim earlier.

maria: yes — if v2 responds with `model_variant_unavailable`, we fall back to v1 and increment a counter `v2_fallback.model_unavailable`. roll-forward probe will keep a small cache of requests to replay under different quantization settings.

tyler: can the console show this as a distinct rollout tile? want ops to be able to abort if error rate spikes.

console-bot: created rollout card #R-2743: "mux header probe" — includes abort button and live metrics.

aj: telemetry side: prefer we emit a deterministic `version_signal` metric per route and tag with `client_mux:present|absent` + `route_affinity`. helps when we correlate with quota burn.

kevin: what about quota accounting? if request goes to v2 but falls back to v1, which account gets charged?

maria: good q. for the probe only, we will charge v1 to keep customer billing stable. internal quota metric `probe_route_actual` will attribute compute to v2 for infra math, but the billing pipeline gets v1 tag. will mark this in the docs.

aj: make sure the usage dashboard shows both: billed tokens (v1) and infra tokens (v2) in separate lines so finance isn't surprised.

tyler: UX ask: when a customer opens the rollout card, add a small note `This probe routes only a subset of clients and does not change billing for end users.` Saves support tickets.

maria: also instrument a maintenance metric `compat_probe_latency_p95_delta` comparing v1->v2 latency on identical requests. we should set an alert if delta > 40ms for 5 minutes.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary=10 hosts, probe=0.5% — logs forwarding enabled.

kevin: debug snippet for header shim in case folks need to inspect: ```
X-Client-MUX: v2
X-Fallback-Reason: model_variant_unavailable
```

aj: one more: sampling rate for traces should be higher for probe flows (10%) so we can get concrete examples of token-level diffs. but mask user PII.

maria: agreed. i'll add sampling in the rollout config and a masking transform.

tyler: do we have any console telemetry widget that surfaces `client_version_entropy`? could be useful to decide when to widen the probe.

console-bot: added metric `client_version_entropy` to the rollout card. shows a mini histogram over last 24h.

kevin: last thing — add a quick rollback play in the card: toggle that forces `X-Client-MUX` to be ignored and drains canary hosts. ops should be able to hit it without an infra pager.

maria: will do. i'll push the rollout config PR and request reviews. tagging @aj for telemetry and @kevin for fallback tests.

aj: ack, i'll review and add the metric docs.

kevin: ack — i'll prep a small test matrix (token-delta, likelihood drift, 5xx regression).

maria: thanks all. will post the PR link and a 1-line summary in #eng-platform when it's up. :rocket:
